description: Where agents run: this machine or other machines over SSH.
machines: Machines that agents can run on over SSH. Keys come from your SSH agent and ~/.ssh/config; passwords are not asked.
machine.id: Stable id: letters, digits and hyphens.
machine.name: Name shown next to the machine's agents.
machine.host: SSH destination: an alias from ~/.ssh/config or user@host.
machine.port: SSH port, if not the default or the one in ~/.ssh/config.
machine.folder: Project folder on the machine; ~/… is the remote home. Empty: the home folder.
openTerminal: Open a terminal on a machine (drop files into it to upload)
openFolder: Open a folder of a machine in a terminal…
